name: Eduling course catalog overview
alternate_phrasings: How many languages does Eduling support?
description: Eduling's public catalog groups its offerings into test preparation, teacher development, courses for specific purposes, and general English. The website currently advertises 20+ courses and 50+ target languages for EdulingAI practice. A newer Eduling article mentions 144 target-language varieties; the team should confirm the preferred public claim with the client before deployment.

name: Differences among Eduling courses
alternate_phrasings: What is the difference between the courses?
Which type of course should I choose?
description: Test-preparation courses focus on exam formats, strategies, and practice. General English courses build communication and vocabulary. Pronunciation and special-purpose courses focus on particular skills or goals. Teacher-development courses provide educators with techniques, resources, and professional learning.
